info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Logistics Shipments Proofs-v2-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Proofs API provides functionality to retrieve documentation and proof of shipments within the logistics framework. This endpoint is essential for businesses needing to access detailed records of shipment proofs, ensuring transparency and verification in the logistics process. Typical consumers include logistics coordinators, warehouse managers, and supply chain analysts who require up-to-date shipment documentation for compliance and operational oversight. With this API, users can efficiently access and manage shipment proof records, enhancing traceability and accountability in logistics operations.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to obtain the proof of shipment for a given shipment. It provides essential details to verify the shipment's status and documentation.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving proof of shipment information. This body should conform to the expected format specified in the schema and must include all required fields for successful processing.

201.description: Successfully retrieved the proof for the shipment.
